messages:
aj (SDK): Heads up — I hit an onboarding bug where the Node SDK rejects the embeddings call the sample app uses. REST works fine. :eyes:

aj (SDK): Repro: call to /v1/embeddings with model=X and input=[...]. REST curl returns 200 + embedding. SDK throws 400: "unknown parameter 'modelName'"

aj (SDK): REST curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-small-v2","input":["hello"]}'
```

aj (SDK): Node sample (what we ship in quickstart):
```js
const rwd = require('@redwood/sdk');
const embeddings = await rwd.embeddings.create({
  modelName: 'open-embed-small-v2',
  input: ['hello']
});
```

aj (SDK): Error from SDK: 
"400 Bad Request - unknown parameter: modelName"

maya (DevEx): Oof. Do we have a mapping table for REST params -> SDK names? I thought we normalized to stable names but maybe got inverted for embeddings.

lorenzo (Runtime): Looks like the runtime expects `model` in the body. Our SDK layer changed the param to `modelName` when we renamed fields earlier this quarter. The server side still accepts `model`. SDK should map `modelName` -> `model` before sending.

aj (SDK): Confirmed. Quick hack in local patch fixes it. But also saw auth retry differences: when token refresh happens the SDK retries automatically, while the CLI/sdk sample app flow sometimes 401s if refresh race happens. The REST curl doesn't exercise refresh logic so it hides the issue.

sam (PM): This explains a couple of onboarding tickets where users see immediate 400s or intermittent 401s. Which doc pages show the sample app right now?

maya (DevEx): Quickstart guides (docs/getting-started/embeddings.md) and the Node quickstart repo. I'll flag the docs if code samples are wrong.

lorenzo (Runtime): Two fixes: 1) SDK client should map param names (back-compat). 2) Make the server accept both `model` and `modelName` for a transitional period. I'll open runtime PR to allow the alias.

aj (SDK): I'll open an SDK PR to map fields and add a unit test that posts the exact JSON the sample app emits. Also adding an integration test that forces token refresh during a call to reproduce the 401 race.

ci-bot: Build queued for aj/sdk-param-fix (#234) :rocket:

aj (SDK): Estimated patch + tests in today’s sprint. I'll ping when CI passes.

maya (DevEx): I'll update the quickstart to use `model` for now and add a short note about SDK versions that changed param names. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting note: "If you see 400 unknown parameter modelName, upgrade SDK or use `model` in request body."

sam (PM): Good. Can we also add a smoke check in our onboarding CI that runs the quickstart sample end-to-end so this doesn't regress?

lorenzo (Runtime): Agree — adding a smoke e2e check to the docs pipeline.

aj (SDK): Action items: 
- aj: PR to map modelName -> model + tests (in progress)
- lorenzo: runtime alias for model/modelName (will PR)
- maya: docs quickstart update + troubleshooting blurb
- sam: add quickstart smoke to onboarding CI

aj (SDK): tagging @maya @lorenzo for visibility, will update thread when CI is green. :thumbsup:
